# Motion dependency

GSAP 3.14.2, reused from the workspace's existing Day-02 distribution.

- Original source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license
- Original copyright and license header preserved.

GSAP eases the light preview and the page's entry/reveal animations. The lighting
controls, saved settings, sharing, navigation, and content also work without GSAP.
